projects.name: Smart-Bridge: AI Chatbot & Analytics Dashboard
description: Built an AI-powered chatbot using NLP and LLMs for multilingual translation and mock-interview practice, used daily by students.
Developed a real-time analytics dashboard with Python and SQL to track user engagement and performance metrics, improving retention by 20%.
Streamlined end-to-end data workflows and delivered weekly stakeholder insights using data storytelling techniques.

projects.name: Gurgaon House Price Prediction
description: Analyzed 19,000+ Gurgaon property listings to uncover agent-driven overpricing patterns of 10-20%, undermining price transparency for home buyers.

Engineered features, tuned XGBoost and Random Forest models, and deployed via a Streamlit web application — reducing overpricing by 15% and saving buyers up to ₹10 Lakhs per transaction across 500+ valuations.

projects.name: Global E-Commerce Revenue Intelligence
description: Conducted an executive portfolio analysis across $1.51M in gross merchandise value (GMV), 1,200 orders, 10 international markets, and 8 product categories.
Implemented Pareto 80/20 concentration modeling demonstrating robust diversification, with 7 of 10 markets contributing to the core 80% revenue benchmark.
Identified Home Decor as the top category ($232.3K gross volume, $1,442 AOV) alongside peak weekly order velocity patterns on Wednesdays ($277K).

projects.name: HR Attrition & Workforce Retention Analytics Dashboard
description: Conducted end-to-end People Analytics on 1,400+ employee records (IBM HR Analytics dataset) to identify key drivers of workplace turnover, identifying burnout (30.5% attrition under overtime) and specific high-risk roles (Sales Reps at 39.8%).
Designed interactive multi-page Power BI dashboard featuring dynamic DAX measures (Attrition Rate, Retention %, Headcount Trends) and custom cohort binning (Tenure, Age groups).
Delivered actionable HR retention recommendations targeting overtime caps, compensation reviews, and early-career engagement to reduce turnover risk by an estimated 12–15%.

projects.name: Weather Intelligence & Climate Analytics Platform (WICAP)
description: Designing and building an enterprise-grade, end-to-end weather and climate analytics platform covering data ingestion, ETL, warehousing, and interactive dashboards.

Architecting a data pipeline with a data quality framework (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness) and building trend, seasonal, and anomaly-detection dashboards filterable by geography, date, and metric.
